verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a GPU accelerator, not a hosted service that keeps user data in a vendor account, so 'export all of my data and leave' is the wrong axis for this kind of product. ROCm being open source and the Prometheus-format metrics exporter are adjacent openness features, not data-portability export, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
